sourceEvidence.label: Loom passkey account discovery working snapshot

assessment.summary: The WebAuthn user handle is already the correct stable account locator; rename it to accountHandle and model UNBOUND, ACTIVE, STALE, and INVALID explicitly.

opportunities.title: Model passkey account status instead of replacing the account locator

tradeoffs.assessment: Keeps locator non-authoritative and makes stale credentials fail closed.
Retains one bounded account lookup.
Adds no on-chain state.
Matches WebAuthn userHandle lifecycle across replacement credentials.
Explicit states make activation and stale-key incidents diagnosable.
Requires a clean ABI and schema rename across the new deployment generation.
Identifies one credential but retains first-write griefing and adds binding lifecycle.
Lookup can remain constant.
Each replacement credential needs another binding or cleanup.
Recovery changes the authenticator-chosen credential ID.
Requires stale-binding and revocation policy.
Changes registry schema and recovery orchestration.
Can only be a hint; live assertion remains required.
A successful local read may avoid registry lookup.
Stores per-credential opaque data.
Support is optional and writing requires a later authentication.
Absence has several meanings and needs fallback.
Could be added only as an optional cache.
Adds a provider-controlled discovery dependency.
A central indexed lookup is fast.
Duplicates credential-account state off chain.
Clean-device discovery depends on service availability.
Requires service, privacy, retention, backup, and incident ownership.
Introduces a mandatory service and synchronization protocol.
